EGFR.biology: EGFR (epidermal growth factor receptor) kinase; canonical oncology target (NSCLC, colorectal, head-and-neck).
EGFR.ligand_notes: Well-established kinase-inhibitor warhead space (erlotinib, gefitinib family); literature DOI 10.1056/NEJMoa020938; 10.1056/NEJMoa020910.
EGFR.e3_notes: Measured PROTAC degradation rows exist in the packaged context set (CRBN).

KRAS.biology: KRAS is a small GTPase; historically considered undruggable; druggability now centered on allele-specific pockets (e.g., G12C covalent site).
KRAS.ligand_notes: Ligand space is allele-specific/covalent (sotorasib DOI 10.1056/NEJMoa2007241; adagrasib DOI 10.1056/NEJMoa2108395). No packaged binder records in the curated table; no measured PROTAC degradation rows in the packaged context set.
KRAS.e3_notes: No measured E3 precedent in the packaged context set; E3 ranking would be exploratory (expression/context only).

commitments: Planning notes are literature-sourced only; they never substitute for retrieved evidence in /investigate.
A plan never executes compound design and never presents a design result; /design generates candidates, /report summarizes completed artifacts.
